item.title: Inqilab Moncho urges people to refrain from violence
item.description: Inqilab Moncho has urged people to refrain from any form of violence over the death of its spokesperson Sharif Osman Bin Hadi.In a Facebook post on Friday, the socio-cultural platform-formed in the wake of the July Revolution in 2024-called on people to hold protest marches in their respective areas demanding the arrest and trial of those responsible for the killing.The platform also sought prayers for the departed soul of Hadi, a prominent figure of the July Uprising, spokesperson of Inqilab Mo

item.title: Hadi's body to arrive in Dhaka on Friday evening
item.description: The body of Sharif Osman Hadi, spokesperson of the Inqilab Moncho, will be brought home from Singapore on Friday evening.A commercial flight of Biman Bangladesh Airlines carrying the body is scheduled to depart Singapore around 3:50PM (local time), Inqilab Moncho said in a post on its Facebook page in the early hours of Friday.The flight is expected to land at Dhaka airport around 6:05PM (Bangladesh time), it added.The post also said, the namaz-e-janaza for Hadi will be held on Manik Mia Avenue

item.title: Hadi's village home Nalchhity engulfed in grief
item.description: Gloom descended on the village home of Inqilab Moncho spokesperson Sharif Osman bin Hadi in the Khasmahal area of Nalchhity municipality in Jhalakathi as news of his death spread.Relatives and well-wishers rushed to the house upon hearing the news. However, due to security concerns, no family members spoke to visitors or the media on Thursday night. item.title: State mourning on Saturday over death of Hadi: Yunus

item.title: Special prayers to be offered in all mosques today
item.description: Special prayers and munajat will be offered after Jum'a prayers in all mosques across the country on Friday seeking the eternal peace of Shaheed Sharif Osman Hadi.The Islamic Foundation, in a press release on Thursday night, requested khatibs and imams of all mosques to hold special prayers and munajat today after Jummah prayers.Hadi, a fearless frontline fighter of the July Uprising and spokesperson of the Inqilab Mancha, passed away on Thursday while undergoing treatment at a Singapore hospita

item.title: Arson attack on Prothom Alo, The Daily Star offices; Army deployed
item.description: Angry protesters made vandalism and set on fire The Daily Star and Prothom Alo offices in the capital's Karwan Bazar late night.The unrest escalated at night over the death of Inqilab Moncho Spokesperson Sharif Osman Hadi.The protesters entered the offices breaking gate and made vandalism.At least 20 employees were initially trapped on the roof of the Daily Star building, several others reportedly trapped in different floors. Firefighters brought the blaze of The Daily Star under control at 1:40

item.title: Saturday's DU Science Unit exam postponed
item.description: The admission test for Science Unit of Dhaka University's (DU) undergraduate program for the 2025-26 academic year, scheduled to be held on Saturday (December 20), has been postponed.A press release signed by Mohammad Rafiqul Islam, acting director of the university's public relations department, informed this on Friday.

item.title: AL office in Rajshahi city demolished

item.title: Fakhrul condemns attacks on media organisations
item.description: BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has strongly condemned the attacks on The Daily Star, Prothom Alo, New Age Editor Nurul Kabir and other media professionals.''Those who carried out such violence are 'enemies of Bangladesh'."
